title: Real functions on finite product spaces
statement: For a type $\Omega$ and a natural number $n$, let $\mathrm{ProductL2}(\Omega,n)$ be the space of real-valued functions on the set of maps from $\{0,\ldots,n-1\}$ to $\Omega$.
